thread:
incident-bot: 🔔 ALERT: smart-routing:region-fallback-loop detected between us-east <-> us-west <-> eu at 2026-03-15T05:20:01Z. error-rate spike observed, auto-fallback cycling. paging oncall-sre

oncall-sre: ack. I'm on it. seeing repeated health-check flips for backend-service v2 on us-east, then us-west, then eu.

sam: I see the same in the router logs — 503s + `fallback: trigger variant MISMATCH` messages. looks like when a region fails, routing falls back to a different model variant that then fails healthcheck and triggers bounce back.

jia: tagging product: @maria-pm — any customer-facing features using v2 variant specifically?

maria-pm: @jia some enterprise customers pinned to v2 for compat. support ticket queue shows 2 customers complaining about latency/timeouts.

support_ash: CustomerImpact: 2 enterprise tenants (acme-corp, finlytics) seeing increased latencies and request failures for model-inference flows. Estimated ~12% of routed traffic affected since 05:18Z.

oncall-sre: quick triage:
- symptoms: healthcheck flapping across regions, smart-router toggling route policy -> cascade.
- root suspect: healthcheck threshold too aggressive + variant routing fallback set to 'match-closest-variant' which chooses incompatible quantized v1 variant in west causing KV cache mismatch.

ops_lead: can we stop automated fallback while we investigate? that's likely causing the bounce loop.

oncall-sre: I'm going to pause cross-region auto-fallback for the smart-routing policy named `global-fallback-v2` (will redirect to local stable variant only).

deploy-bot: command run by oncall-sre:```sh
redwoodctl routing update-policy --name global-fallback-v2 --auto-fallback=false --actors oncall-sre
# response: policy updated (id=pf-9a3)
```

sam: nice. logs after update: routing no longer sends cross-region fallbacks. error rate dropping in us-west.

jia: can we also pin the eu region to v2-compat (the variant that's known working) while we validate config?

oncall-sre: I'll create a temporary variant pin for eu:```json
{"region":"eu","service":"backend-service","variant":"v2-compat","scope":"temporary","expires":"1h"}```

deploy-bot: variant pin applied by oncall-sre (pin-id=pin-443).

maria-pm: CS update: emailing acme-corp + finlytics with preliminary note: "we're investigating cross-region health flaps causing intermittent failures; mitigation in progress."

support_ash: adding support tickets: INC-1234, INC-1235. logging affected request ids.

sam: found root cause: a recent canary of quantized variant v1 introduced a KV-cache format change. When router fell back from v2 to v1, the runtime rejected prefix KV leading to immediate fail and then routing bounced back. entire loop continues until auto-fallback exhausts or stabilizes.

jia: timeline:
- 05:17:22Z canary v1 pushed to us-west (small batch)
- 05:18:36Z first healthcheck fail observed in us-west
- 05:18:55Z router tried fallback to eu-v1 -> eu failed (incompatible)
- 05:19:12Z routing fell back to us-east, which was then de-graded etc.

ops_lead: mitigation plan:
1) keep auto-fallback disabled (done).
2) immediately roll back v1 canary in us-west (if still live).
3) apply variant pin for eu/us-east to stable v2-compat for 1h (done for eu, pending us-east).
4) widen healthcheck thresholds to reduce flapping while we finish rollback.
5) postmortem & stricter variant compatibility gating.

oncall-sre: rolling back canary in us-west now.```sh
redwoodctl deploy rollback --service backend-service --region us-west --deployment canary-v1
# response: rollback started (task-id=rb-901)
```

deploy-bot: rollback confirmed: task rb-901 completed. us-west now serving v2-compat.

sam: error-rate trending down to baseline (5m window). latency for affected tenants recovering.

maria-pm: CS: sent follow-up to customers with ETA ~30m for full recovery. asked to escalate if still impacted.

support_ash: noticed a couple of recurring user request-IDs that failed due to `KV_FORMAT_MISMATCH` — captured for engineering debug.

oncall-sre: widening healthcheck from 3/10 fails to 5/15 for inter-region probes to reduce sensitivity for the next 30m.```yaml
healthcheck:
  path: /healthz
  failure_threshold: 5
  interval: 10s
  timeout: 2s
```

deploy-bot: healthcheck update applied to policy id policy-hc-77 by oncall-sre.

jia: quick safety question — did we have any rollback protections (compatibility checks) that should have caught kv format mismatch?

sam: yes, in theory the variant gating has schema checks but the recent change slipped because the canary used an opaque binary cache change not validated by unit tests. will add runtime KV sanity check on load.

ops_lead: can you draft a short action list & owner assignment?

oncall-sre: ACTIONS:
- sam: add runtime KV format validation (PR by EOD)
- jia: expand pre-deploy canary compatibility test matrix to include KV prefix cases (owner: jia, PRs by tomorrow)
- ops_lead: review fallback policy thresholds & default to conservative for cross-region fallbacks (owner: ops_lead, change by tomorrow)
- maria-pm + support_ash: customer follow-ups & RCA comms (owner: maria-pm, initial update in 1hr)
- oncall-sre: write incident notes + metrics snapshot (owner: oncall-sre, initial draft in 2h)

maria-pm: thanks — tagging exec update channel after we have the metrics snapshot.

support_ash: I'll keep tickets updated and escalate if any more reports come in.

oncall-sre: current status: mitigations applied, error-rate back to normal, affected customers have been notified. leaving the thread open for follow-up and postmortem.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated, severity=sev2, duration=~13m, mitigations: rollback canary, pinned variants, disabled auto-fallback, widened healthchecks.

ops_lead: good work everyone. postmortem assigned to sam/jia/oncall-sre. please include timeline, monitoring gaps, and action items.

sam: will add logs + request-ids we captured.

oncall-sre: closing on-call handoff in 30m unless anything else pops. :thumbsup:

maria-pm: draft message for customers approved, will send once metrics confirm no regression.

support_ash: INC-1234/1235 updated -> resolved (pending customer confirmation).

deploy-bot: automated note: deploy windows unaffected. no additional rollbacks required.

oncall-sre: final note: this was primarily a variant-compatibility + aggressive fallback interaction. we're updating gating to prevent similar loops.
